I am a proteomics data scientist, computational biologist, and statistical programmer with a PhD in Biology. I develop computational tools and reproducible analytical solutions that connect biological questions with statistical reasoning, informatics, and automation.

In multidisciplinary teams, I connect experimental biologists, clinicians, statisticians, and computational specialists, translating shared analytical decisions into transparent tools, workflows, and interpretable results. At the University of Freiburg, my work spans protein interactions, proteolytic activity, complexome profiling, interaction proteomics, and integrative multi-omics analysis using modular R and Bash pipelines.

## Selected Publications

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.publication-card}
### TermineR: Extracting information on endogenous proteolytic processing from shotgun proteomics data
Software and method paper for extracting endogenous proteolytic processing information from shotgun proteomics.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1002/pmic.202300491) | [Project](https://github.com/MiguelCos/TermineR)
:::

::: {.publication-card}
### Proteometabolomics of initial and recurrent glioblastoma
Clinical proteomics and multi-omics integration study of recurrent glioblastoma biology.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1093/neuonc/noad208) | [Analysis project](projects/gbm-proteometabolomics/)
:::

::: {.publication-card}
### Proteome alterations in human autopsy tissues in relation to time after death
Necrodegradomics study with openly available preprocessing, statistical analysis, reports, and visualizations.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00018-023-04754-3) | [Analysis project](projects/necrodegradomics/)

### Recent Collaboration Publications

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.publication-card}
### A single-amino-acid cleavage controls global mitochondrial complex integrity
Quantitative complexome profiling shows how loss of ICP55 processing destabilizes mitochondrial protein assemblies.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41594-026-01876-7) | [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42675210/)
:::

::: {.publication-card}
### Distinct Assembly Complexes Facilitate cbb~3~-type Cytochrome Oxidase Maturation
Complexome profiling resolves stable assembly intermediates involved in bacterial cytochrome oxidase maturation.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmb.2026.169945) | [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42447953/)
:::

::: {.publication-card}
### Fractionated proteomics identifies a protein network mitigating resistance exercise-induced damage
Human muscle fractionation, proteomics, and phosphoproteomics reveal a BAG3-linked proteostasis network, supported by a public analysis workflow.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-75501-y) | [Analysis project](projects/bag3-fractionated-proteomics/)
:::
:::
